POST Collection Log API

/api/collection-log

Generate collection log images showing obtained items and completion progress.

📋 Overview

The Collection Log API generates beautiful collection log images for OSRS items, showing completion status and detailed item information. Perfect for sharing rare drops and collection achievements.

Features

  • Item Information: Displays item name, examine text, and icon
  • User Customization: Custom username display
  • Professional Styling: Clean design with OSRS theme
  • High Resolution: Crisp images suitable for sharing
  • Automatic Lookup: Fetches item data from OSRS Wiki
  • Error Handling: Graceful fallbacks for missing items

📊 Request Format

The API expects a JSON payload with the following structure:

{ "itemName": "Jar of dirt", "userName": "TestPlayer" }

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Description
itemName string Yes Name of the item to display
userName string Yes Username to display on the image

📊 Response Format

The API returns a JSON response with the generated image data:

{ "success": true, "image_url": "data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAA...", "message": "Collection log generated successfully" }
